question: Who among the following medieval rulers focused his attention on the construction of sarai (shelter) for the convenience of travelers?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Sher Shah Suri.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sher Shah Suri, a medieval ruler, focused on the construction of sarai for the convenience of travelers.**
 
• **Sarai were shelters that provided food, water, and lodging for travelers, especially those on long journeys.**
 
• Sher Shah Suri built a network of saris along the** **main roads and highways in his empire, which facilitated travel and trade.
 
• The construction of saris was a significant achievement of Sher Shah Suri's reign, as it improved the infrastructure of the empire and benefited the common people.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Babur was more interested in military conquests.**

 
 
• The Mughal Empire** **in the Indian subcontinent was founded by Babur.
 
 
 
• **Akbar was interested in religious tolerance and administrative reforms.**
 
 
• The reign of Akbar, the third Mughal emperor, lasted from **1556 to 1605.**
 
 
 
• **Humayun was interested in restoring his lost empire.**
 
 
• From 1530 to 1540 and again from 1555 until his death in 1556, Humayun, the second Mughal emperor, ruled over regions that are today Eastern Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Northern India, and Pakistan.
